rationale: Transparent titleBarOverlay control backgrounds support WCO/BrowserWindow with transparent as an optional specific feature. A Testcase Gist URL is supplied; screenshots and a separate crash trace do not replace it as the reproduction evidence. 48193 preserves the transparent background and reports incorrect hover/accent feedback; this case loses the static transparent background through a default-color fallback. The shared titleBarOverlay/rgba setting does not establish the same wrong behavior. Other retrieved transparency/layout reports also have different triggers or objects, so no similar comment is supported. No confirmed Chromium/Node cause, public vulnerability, app-only report or how-to request is present.
